inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: One pure text table — TOXIN / EXPOSURE / ORGAN / IMPACT (header extracts as “TOXIn / eXPOSUre / OrGAn / ImPACT”, odd internal caps) — 12 rows: aflatoxins, alkylating agents, aromatic amines, arsenic (three-organ fan), asbestos, tobacco smoke (eight organs, the interleaved row), ethanol, ionizing radiation, nickel/chromium/beryllium/silica, nitrosamines, radon, vinyl chloride (organ prints “LiVer”). ZERO raster images on the page (pdfimages + VLM census, two rounds).
inventory.kypLocation: the registry visual (four bands: FUNGI & CHEMICALS / METALS & DUSTS / RADIATION / LIFESTYLE, the multi-organ fan chips, the angiosarcoma-pair callout, the radon #2 note) + blocks[1] the table carried verbatim + blocks[2] the tobacco pairing table

notes: The page's single visual element is its text table (pdfimages + VLM census: ZERO rasters) — adapted as the registry visual and carried verbatim in the note's tables. The tobacco row's text-layer interleave is resolved by the VLM census (one row between Asbestos and Ethanol, blank exposure, alphabetical 8-organ list paired line-by-line with 8 impacts) and is documented in the manifest notes. No mnemonics print on the page (VLM confirmed); the four KYP mnemonics are original. Nothing reproduced.
